label: CM-3(5)
title: Automated Security Response

statement.prose: Implement the following security responses automatically if baseline configurations are changed in an unauthorized manner: {{ insert: param, cm-03.05_odp }}.

guidance: Automated security responses include halting selected system functions, halting system processing, and issuing alerts or notifications to organizational personnel when there is an unauthorized modification of a configuration item.

params.label: security responses
guidelines: security responses to be automatically implemented are defined;
